action.objective: Capture the d7 bishop with the queen to win material outright, then assess Black's best reply.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search found e7d7 exact (+387) as top move; the reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) is allocated to this candidate. Qxd7 wins a bishop for free since Qxd7 Bxd7 recovers only the queen for bishop+knight already captured. Need full depth-4 single-candidate verification to confirm no Black tactic (e.g., Rxd7 tricks or back-rank issues) before committing.
